flagged_for_human_review.title: The shared hide-and-recover holdout has no demonstrated external validity
flagged_for_human_review.measurement: Spearman 0.144 (p=0.12) between holdout DTI and reported leaderboard score across all 118 recovered submissions.
flagged_for_human_review.consequence: Every prior promotion/STOP decision in this repo that rested on HOLDOUT-DTI as a proxy for leaderboard score is unsupported by this test. The holdout is still a valid measurement of catalogue-recovery, not of hidden-test performance.
flagged_for_human_review.fix: Report holdout numbers only as catalogue-recovery, never as a score estimate. Done in this session.

flagged_for_human_review.title: The literal '>70% of dots within 3 px' registry gate is degenerate
flagged_for_human_review.measurement: The 5 px lattice r13 (206,895 dots) puts 99.68% of this submission's dots within 3 px; its overlap lift versus a density-matched independent field is only 1.47x.
flagged_for_human_review.consequence: Any dense registry raster makes the gate unpassable for every non-empty submission, including pure noise. The gate as written cannot distinguish duplication from coincidence.
flagged_for_human_review.fix: Replaced by a density-matched overlap lift plus the surface Spearman test; both are reported.

flagged_for_human_review.title: 118 reported scores are not 118 independent observations
flagged_for_human_review.measurement: They collapse to 22 transitive families (largest 95). Leave-one-out R2 0.334 becomes leave-one-family-out R2 -0.847.
flagged_for_human_review.consequence: In-sample and leave-one-out fits on this history are optimistic. Grouped cross-validation must be used for any claim.

flagged_for_human_review.title: Reported scores are internally inconsistent at the 0.02-0.09 level
flagged_for_human_review.measurement: At >95% dot overlap the median |score difference| is 0.0175 and the maximum is 0.0856; the worst pair is h33-h33-2-b2-20261004T220000Z-e5eb6e7e-z (0.2778) vs h19-5-powerlaw-budget-multiline-corrobor (0.1922).
flagged_for_human_review.consequence: The nine-site top six (0.2649-0.2778) are statistically tied; ranking them is not meaningful.

flagged_for_human_review.title: The 'consensus agreement' signal is a duplication artefact
flagged_for_human_review.measurement: Spearman 0.643 (any-support enrichment, n=118) falls to family-level Spearman 0.241 (p=0.28, n=22 families).
flagged_for_human_review.consequence: Placing dots where the historical pool also placed them is not evidence of a better prior.

flagged_for_human_review.title: The 19-band feature stack and 1 m DEM are unobtainable in this environment
flagged_for_human_review.measurement: competition data requires DrivenData login; the public Dropbox mirrors are egress-blocked; no copy is committed in any of the 204 public GEMSDOE repositories.
flagged_for_human_review.consequence: Supervised fault prediction (the reference solution) cannot be reproduced or trained here. This caps achievable localisation precision and therefore the leaderboard score.
flagged_for_human_review.fix: Run scripts/download_competition_data.sh on an unrestricted machine, then scripts/prepare_data.py.
